claim: Anthropic's OAuth login authentication is designed exclusively for ordinary, individual (interactive) use of Claude subscription plans, not for third-party programmatic/automated access.
stance_target: automated/programmatic use of consumer subscription credentials violates vendor policy
scope_conditions: Claude Code / Claude.ai OAuth authentication, Free/Pro/Max/Team/Enterprise plans
quoted_support: OAuth authentication is intended exclusively for purchasers of Claude Free, Pro, Max, Team, and Enterprise subscription plans and is designed to support ordinary use of Claude Code and other native Anthropic applications.

claim: Anthropic requires developers building products/services that interact with Claude's capabilities, including via the Agent SDK, to use API key authentication rather than subscription OAuth.
stance_target: metered API billing is the required path for programmatic/automated access, distinct from subscription tiers
scope_conditions: Agent SDK and third-party product developers
quoted_support: Developers building products or services that interact with Claude's capabilities, including those using the Agent SDK, should use API key authentication through Claude Console or a supported cloud provider.

claim: Anthropic explicitly prohibits third-party developers from routing requests through Free, Pro, or Max subscription credentials on behalf of their own users.
stance_target: automation harnesses that reuse consumer subscription auth for third-party services violate ToS
quoted_support: Anthropic does not permit third-party developers to offer Claude.ai login into their own applications, or to route requests through Free, Pro, or Max plan credentials on behalf of their users.

claim: Anthropic reserves the right to enforce authentication restrictions against automated/third-party use of subscription credentials without prior notice.
stance_target: violating the automation/subscription-auth policy risks sudden enforcement (rate limiting, suspension) without warning
quoted_support: Anthropic reserves the right to take measures to enforce these restrictions and may do so without prior notice.

claim: Advertised Pro and Max plan usage limits are calculated assuming ordinary individual (non-automated, non-agentic-at-scale) usage patterns.
stance_target: heavy automated/agentic workloads exceed the intended use envelope of flat-rate consumer tiers, which may trigger rate-limit enforcement
scope_conditions: Claude Pro and Max subscription tiers
quoted_support: Advertised usage limits for Pro and Max plans assume ordinary, individual usage of Claude Code and the Agent SDK.

claim: Developers may not collect, store, or intermediate Claude.ai credentials or session tokens; sign-in must go through Anthropic's own flow.
stance_target: third-party automation tools that capture/replay subscription session tokens violate policy
quoted_support: developers may not collect, store, or intermediate Claude.ai credentials or session tokens — sign-in to a Claude account must complete through Anthropic's own flow.
